risks.risk: Wrong item size/length ("over 4 feet") leading to mispricing
risks.proof: Ask for a photo with a measuring tape laid along the sofa length from one end to the other (or a clear measurement in cm/feet).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller/uncertain-length used sofa (worst-case size for value).

risks.risk: Hidden damage or poor upholstery condition (stains, tears, sagging cushions) not visible in this single angle
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of: (1) seat cushion seams, (2) backrest corners, (3) underside/legs, and (4) any stain/tear areas in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible wear (worst-case: treat as needing cleaning and with unknown cushion firmness).

risks.risk: Frame/spring weakness (sagging) that affects comfort and resale value
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of someone sitting/pressing the cushions from front and back, showing bounce and whether it stays firm.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed firm (worst-case: assume cushion/frame may be soft).

risks.risk: Material type uncertainty (leather vs faux leather vs fabric) affecting durability and price
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up of the upholstery texture and the underside/edge where material is clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for upholstery type (worst-case: treat as fabric/faux with higher wear risk).

proof_requests: Provide a measuring-tape photo showing the sofa length (end-to-end) to confirm "over 4 feet".
Send close-up photos of seams, corners, and any stains/tears in bright light.
Send a short video showing cushion firmness (sit/press test) and whether it sags.
Show a close-up of upholstery texture and underside/legs to confirm material type and construction.
response.reason: From photo 0, the item looks like a small upholstered sofa/bench, but the key pricing drivers (exact length/size, upholstery material, and true condition/firmness) are not provable from this single image. Request the measurement and condition proof before pricing.
